roles.name: Shadehold
roles.contract: Holds the top road alone. Win your duel or stay even, keep your Needles standing, and arrive at the big fights as a front line.

roles.name: Grovehunter
roles.contract: Has no road. Hunt the camps in the Dialwood, catch enemies who walk too far up a road, and lead your team to the big objectives.

roles.name: Dialcross
roles.contract: Holds the short center road across the Seat. Clear your wave fast, then cross to a side road and turn its fight before the enemy can follow.

roles.name: Shaftlight
roles.contract: Shares the bottom road with your Lampglass. Last-hit every Wick you can, stay behind your front line, and become the team's steady damage late in the match.

roles.name: Lampglass
roles.contract: Shares the bottom road and leaves the Gleam to your Shaftlight. Shield and heal them, start or stop fights, and light up the map so your team sees danger first.

classes.name: Plinth
classes.desc: Stands at the front and takes the hits. Plinths start fights, pin enemies in place and keep allies behind them safe.
classes.shape: Block: widest at the shoulders (at least 1.4 times the hips), flat crown, square stance.

classes.name: Breaker
classes.desc: Fights up close and stays standing. Breakers trade blow for blow, crack the front line and wear down anyone who lingers near them.
classes.shape: Inverted wedge: heavy shoulders narrowing to the feet, one oversized weapon carried on one side.

classes.name: Striker
classes.desc: Picks one target and ends it quickly. Strikers slip past the front line, hit hard in a short window and get out again.
classes.shape: Forward diagonal: narrow body leaning 10 to 15 degrees into the run, asymmetric points.

classes.name: Slinger
classes.desc: Deals steady damage from range. Slingers grow strongest late and need space and cover to keep firing.
classes.shape: Horizontal: a long weapon held across the body (bow, sling, spear-thrower; never a firearm).

classes.name: Caster
classes.desc: Shapes the fight with abilities. Casters land bursts, lay down zones and lock enemies in place from a distance.
classes.shape: Line plus disc: a tall vertical body topped by a headpiece, hood or halo.

classes.name: Tender
classes.desc: Keeps allies alive and the fight in their favor. Tenders heal, shield, speed up and spot for the team.
classes.shape: Round and open, carrying a light vessel (a lamp, bell or glass) at the chest or in hand.

resources.name: Light
resources.desc: Stored light. Abilities spend it; it refills slowly on its own and quickly at your base.

resources.name: Tally
resources.desc: Builds as you attack, take hits and land abilities. Some abilities spend it. It drains after a few seconds out of combat.

resources.name: Heat
resources.desc: Abilities add Heat instead of spending it. A full bar overheats you: no abilities for a moment while it vents. It cools when you stop casting.

resources.name: Unlit
resources.desc: No resource. Abilities are limited by their cooldowns alone.

fighters.name: Ardit
fighters.title: Pavise bearer
fighters.job: Tilts a pane of dawnglass that disarms the fighters swinging at his team.
fighters.lore: Ardit's pavise was a window once, the east pane of a Spire stair, taken down when the stair was cleared for the Dawn Arch road. He carried the glass out on his back and has not set it down since. Aubade children are told that a wall is a thing that waits; Ardit is a wall that turns, tilting the morning into the eyes of whoever lifts a blade. He apologises to the people he disarms. He means it, and he does it again a moment later. The dawn is on his side, and he will hold it open for anyone standing behind him.

passive.name: Turned Blades
passive.desc: Each time Ardit disarms an enemy fighter (at most once per 1.5 s from each enemy), he gains {triggers.0.effects.0.stats.armor} armor and magic resist for 5 s. This stacks up to 3 times.

a1.name: Lancing Run
a1.desc: Ardit runs up to 7 m behind the pavise and stops at the first enemy fighter he meets. They take {effects.0.onPass.0.amount} magic damage and are knocked airborne for 0.75 s.

a2.name: Glare
a2.desc: Ardit tilts the pavise to catch the dawn. Enemies in a 5 m, 70° cone take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage, are slowed by 25% for 1.5 s and are disarmed for {effects.0.onHit.2.duration}.

a3.name: Spire Strike
a3.desc: Ardit drives the pavise's spire into the ground. Enemies within 2.5 m take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage (60% more against monsters) and are slowed by 20% for 1.5 s.

ult.name: Muster
ult.desc: Ardit raises the pavise as a beacon for 5 s. Allied fighters within 6 m, himself included, gain 20% move speed and {effects.0.onTick.0.statScaling.armor} armor and magic resist, and every enemy fighter that enters the 6 m radius is disarmed for 1 s.

fighters.name: Burdam
fighters.title: Grudge holder
fighters.job: Stays on whoever hurt him and makes every one of them pay it back at once.
fighters.lore: Burdam keeps the ledger for a dome-village on the east rim, and the scored mask he wears is that ledger: one cut for every debt owed to his people. He is a generous host and a terrible creditor. Strike him once and he will remember the day, the hour and the angle of the light. Serenade children are told that he has never forgotten a slight, which is not quite true; he has forgiven three. He carries an ironstone cleaver as tall as he is, mostly so that nobody asks about the other ledger.

passive.name: Long Memory
passive.desc: When an enemy fighter damages Burdam, they gain a Grudge stack for 6 s (up to 5; at most one stack per 0.5 s from each enemy). Burdam's basic attacks against a Grudge-bearer heal him for 1.5% of his max Health and give him {triggers.1.effects.1.amount} Tally.

a1.name: Bear Down
a1.desc: Burdam lunges up to 5 m at an enemy and chops them for {effects.0.onArrive.0.amount} physical damage. A Grudge-bearer is also slowed by 40% for 1.5 s.

a2.name: Stubborn
a2.desc: For 3 s Burdam gains {effects.0.statScaling.armor} armor and magic resist and 30% tenacity. When it ends he stamps, dealing {effects.0.onExpire.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage to enemies within 3 m.

a3.name: Old Wound
a3.desc: Burdam cleaves a 4 m, 100° arc for {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage. Grudge-bearers hit take {effects.0.onHit.1.then.0.amount} more physical damage and are slowed by 50%, fading over 2 s.

ult.name: Settled Account
ult.desc: Every Grudge-bearer within 7 m is dragged 3 m toward Burdam and stunned for 0.5 s. Each pays {effects.0.onHit.0.then.0.perStack.0.amount} physical damage per Grudge stack, and Burdam heals 3% of his max Health per stack. This spends the Grudges.

fighters.name: Dunsom
fighters.title: Dusk herder
fighters.job: Moves the enemy where his team wants them: pulled into the pool, pushed off the carry.
fighters.lore: Before the light stopped, Dunsom drove his village's flocks home every dusk. The dusk never ended, so the flocks never went in, and he grew very good at moving things that did not want to be moved. He walks with a lantern hung from the hook of a crook taller than he is, and he speaks to enemies the way he once spoke to goats: kindly, firmly and without any doubt about where they will end up. He believes every quarrel can be settled if everyone simply stands in the right place.

passive.name: Settling
passive.desc: Enemies Dunsom displaces are Settled for {triggers.0.effects.0.duration}. Each time his abilities damage a Settled enemy, they take 12 bonus magic damage, plus 3 per level and 10% of his Power.

a1.name: Draw In
a1.desc: After 0.4 s, enemies within 3 m of a point up to 9 m away take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and are drawn up to 2 m toward its center.

a2.name: Crook Sweep
a2.desc: Dunsom sweeps a wave of dusk 7 m along the ground. Every enemy it touches takes {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and is pushed up to 2.5 m toward the point he aimed at.

a3.name: Step Through Dusk
a3.desc: Dunsom steps through the dusk and reappears up to {effects.0.distance} away.

ult.name: Driving Hour
ult.desc: Dunsom picks a point within 9 m. Every enemy within 5 m of him is hurled up to 5 m toward it, and 0.6 s later the point erupts: enemies within 2.5 m take {effects.2.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and are rooted for 1.25 s.

fighters.name: Ervet
fighters.title: Glass blade
fighters.job: Shatters her own blade into the enemy line, fights fast with the hilt, then swings it whole again.
fighters.lore: Ervet cast her greatsword in dawnglass to be unbreakable, and spent a year finding out she had made it wrong. A blade that cannot break cannot be mended, and a blade that cannot be mended cannot be handed on. Now she breaks it herself, on purpose, in front of whoever stands closest, and fights with what is left in her fist. The shards sing when they land. She says that is the sound of an idea ending, and the whole blade is the sound of it starting again. Aubade duelists argue about whether that is craft or showing off. Ervet does not argue; she has a sword to put back together.

passive.name: Dawnglass Edge
passive.desc: Ervet's attacks deal an extra 2% of her max Health as magic damage. With the blade whole she has +15 armor and magic resist; in Hilt form she has 15 less than her base armor and resist, but moves 20% faster and attacks 30% faster (reach 1.7 m). Her attack on an enemy carrying a lodged shard tears it out: it bursts for 20 + 6 per level (+3% bonus Health) magic damage and slows by 30% for 1 s, to that enemy and everyone within 1.75 m of it.

a1.name: Quick Jab
a1.desc: Ervet jabs with the hilt, dashing 3 m and stopping at the first enemy for {effects.0.onPass.0.amount} magic damage.

a2.name: Shard Kick
a2.desc: Ervet kicks three shards in a 30° fan up to 6 m. Each deals {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and slows by 15% for 1.5 s.

a3.name: Reform
a3.desc: Ervet swings the blade whole again before its time, dealing {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage to enemies within 2 m.

a1.name: Heavy Arc
a1.desc: Ervet sweeps the blade through a 3.5 m, 140° arc, dealing {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.5 s.

a2.name: Glass Guard
a2.desc: Ervet braces behind the blade and shields herself for {effects.0.amount} for 2 s.

a3.name: Shatter
a3.desc: Ervet smashes the blade into the ground: enemies within 3 m take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and are slowed by 40% for 1.5 s. Shards slow by 20% for 2 s and the blade breaks into its Hilt for up to 6 s.

ult.name: Whole Again
ult.desc: Ervet leaps up to 6 m and calls every shard home. As she lands, enemies within 4.5 m take {effects.0.onArrive.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage, are dragged 2 m toward her and each keeps a lodged shard for 6 s. The blade is whole again for 6 s at its usual reach; her attacks tear lodged shards out (see Dawnglass Edge).

fighters.name: Hesmi
fighters.title: Shard bearer
fighters.job: Plants shards of the fallen needle whose shadows slow the enemy, then fall on them.
fighters.lore: When the needle fell, it broke into more pieces than anyone has counted, and Hesmi has spent her life carrying them. She keeps no side's hour. She walks the rim with three shards strapped to her back, and wherever she plants one it casts the shadow the needle should have cast, long and dark and pointing away from her. The Hourless say the shards remember the time. Hesmi says they are just heavy. She is slow to speak, slower to anger, and almost impossible to move.

passive.name: Shade-Fed
passive.desc: Hesmi's basic attacks against Shaded enemies deal {triggers.0.effects.0.amount} bonus physical damage (60% against monsters). While Stand Firm lasts, enemy fighters who hit her become Shaded.

a1.name: Plant Shard
a1.desc: Hesmi drives a shard into the ground up to 6 m away. For 3 s it casts a 9 m by 2.5 m shadow pointing away from her: enemies in it are slowed by 25% and Shaded. Then the shard topples along its shadow: enemies still in it take {effects.0.onExpire.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and are stunned for 0.75 s.

a2.name: Shoulder the Stone
a2.desc: Hesmi lunges 4.5 m. Enemies she passes take {effects.0.onPass.0.amount} physical damage, are knocked 1.5 m aside and become Shaded.

a3.name: Stand Firm
a3.desc: For 2.5 s Hesmi gains {effects.0.statScaling.armor} armor and magic resist and 30% tenacity. Enemy fighters who hit her meanwhile become Shaded.

ult.name: Felled Shard
ult.desc: Hesmi drops a great shard at a point within 9 m. After 0.75 s, enemies under it (2 m) take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and are stunned for 1.25 s. It then throws a 12 m by 5 m shadow for 5 s that slows enemies by 40% and Shades them, while allied fighters in it gain 15% move speed.

fighters.name: Ilsheta
fighters.title: Lamp hanger
fighters.job: Hangs a healing lamp on the ally in the most trouble; the light follows them wherever they run.
fighters.lore: In the Glass Belfry every window has a lamp, and Ilsheta was the girl who climbed the ladders to light them. When the morning stopped she kept climbing, because someone ought to. She hangs dawnglass lamps on people now: on runners heading out, on the wounded coming back, on anyone who looks lost. Aubade elders find her too gentle for the war. Serenade fighters find her lamps following them across the Noonline long after they thought they had escaped her. She is quick, tidy and never late.

passive.name: Warm Hands
passive.desc: Ilsheta's heals restore 40% more to allies who are stunned, rooted, slowed, airborne, asleep, feared or taunted, and give them 15% move speed for 1.5 s (once per 4 s per ally).

a1.name: Glint Bolt
a1.desc: Ilsheta throws a dawnglass bolt up to 9 m. The first enemy hit takes {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and is slowed by 25% for 1.5 s.

a2.name: Hung Lamp
a2.desc: Ilsheta hangs a lamp on an allied fighter or herself for 4 s. Every 0.5 s it heals allied fighters within 3 m of its bearer for {effects.0.onTick.0.amount}, and enemies in its light are revealed and slowed by 10%.

a3.name: Dawnglass Shell
a3.desc: Ilsheta shields an allied fighter or herself for {effects.0.amount} for 2.5 s and gives them 20% move speed for 1 s.

ult.name: Every Window Lit
ult.desc: Ilsheta lights a lamp on every allied fighter within 9 m, herself included, for 5 s. Each lamp heals its bearer for {effects.0.onHit.0.effects.0.amount} every 0.5 s (Warm Hands applies) and reveals enemy fighters within 2.5 m of it.

fighters.name: Kemdo
fighters.title: Burning glass
fighters.job: Dives one target, empties her Heat bar in two seconds, vents and goes again.
fighters.lore: Kemdo ground her glaive's lens herself from a pane of fallen dawnglass, and it took her a year. Held at the right angle it gathers the stopped sun into a single burning point, and Kemdo has spent a great deal of time finding the right angle. She belongs to no side and sells her heat to whichever camp pays in food and quiet. She runs hot, cools fast and does not hold grudges, which makes her restful company between fights and unbearable during them.

passive.name: Cooling Kill
passive.desc: When Kemdo takes part in an enemy fighter's takedown, all her Heat vents at once. It does not shorten an overheat already under way.

a1.name: Long Thrust
a1.desc: Kemdo thrusts along a 4.5 m line, dealing {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage. Slowed enemies also take {effects.0.onHit.1.then.0.amount} damage that ignores armor and resist (half against monsters).

a2.name: Heat Shimmer
a2.desc: Kemdo dashes 5 m and leaves a heat shimmer along her path for 2 s that slows enemies inside by 25%.

a3.name: Vent
a3.desc: Kemdo releases 50 Heat in a 3 m blast: enemies take {effects.1.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and are knocked back 1 m, and she gains {effects.2.statScaling.armor} armor and magic resist for 1.5 s. Vent costs no Heat and can be cast while overheated.

ult.name: Held Focus
ult.desc: Kemdo focuses the stopped sun on an enemy fighter within 6 m for 3 s. A 2 m spot follows them and deals {effects.0.onTick.0.amount} damage that ignores armor and resist every 0.5 s to every enemy in it, and Kemdo gains {effects.1.stats.omnivamp} Drain for the duration.

fighters.name: Lisvel
fighters.title: Morning archer
fighters.job: Shoots from far back and leaves lines of morning light her team can run along.
fighters.lore: Lisvel believes that light is a road. She stands at the back of the fight with an ash longbow as long as she is tall and draws a line of morning from her feet to the far side of the dial, and then she lets her friends run along it. Aubade archers are taught to hit what they aim at. Lisvel was taught to give the wind somewhere to go. She hums when she shoots, always the first four notes of the dawn song, and always stops before the fifth, in case someone behind her wants to finish it.

passive.name: Reach of Morning
passive.desc: Each ability that hits an enemy fighter adds 0.4 m to Lisvel's attack range for 5 s, up to 3 times (once per 1.5 s from each enemy).

a1.name: Dawn Line
a1.desc: Lisvel looses an arrow up to 10 m that passes through every enemy on its path, dealing {effects.2.onHit.0.amount} physical damage to each. The path stays lit for 3 s: allies on it, Lisvel included, move {effects.0.onTick.0.power} faster, and enemies crossing it are slowed by 15%.

a2.name: Backstep
a2.desc: Lisvel hops 3 m away from the cursor. Her next attack within 3 s reaches 2 m farther and slows the target by 25% for 1.5 s.

a3.name: Morning Draw
a3.desc: Lisvel draws faster, gaining 30/35/40/45/50% attack speed for 4 s.

ult.name: Sun Corridor
ult.desc: After 0.75 s a 14 m by 3 m shaft of light lands, dealing {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and slowing enemies by 40%. It stays for 5 s: allies inside move 30% faster, and Lisvel gains 20% attack speed while she stands in it.

fighters.name: Marund
fighters.title: Dome mason
fighters.job: Raises a dome no enemy can step into, so the ally who got caught has three safe seconds.
fighters.lore: Marund raised half the drum walls of the Lamp Dome with his own maul, and he still tests a finished course by knocking on it. Serenade masons say a dome is not done until someone has sheltered under it, so he brings the habit into every fight: he finds whoever is most frightened and builds the evening around them. He speaks slowly, laughs at his own jokes before he reaches the end of them, and has never let an Aubade runner past a wall he set. The stopped evening suits him. There is always time to lay one more course.

passive.name: Hearthside
passive.desc: Allied fighters within 5 m of Marund, himself included, regenerate 0.4% of Marund's max Health every second.

a1.name: Shoulder In
a1.desc: Marund charges up to 4.5 m and stops at the first enemy, dealing {effects.0.onPass.0.amount} magic damage and knocking them back 2 m. The target is slowed by 30% for 1.5 s, or rooted for 1.25 s instead if it is Mortared (this spends the Mortar).

a2.name: Shelter Dome
a2.desc: Marund raises a 3 m dome around himself for {effects.1.duration}. Enemies inside are pushed 2.5 m away from him, and no enemy can walk in while it stands; allies come and go freely. Allied fighters inside, Marund included, gain {effects.1.onTick.0.statScaling.armor} armor and magic resist.

a3.name: Mortar Pail
a3.desc: Marund lobs wet mortar up to 8 m. After 0.5 s, enemies within 2 m take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage, are slowed by 35% for 1.5 s and are Mortared for 4 s. Shoulder In roots a Mortared enemy.

ult.name: Domefall
ult.desc: Marund leaps up to 7 m, unstoppable. Where he lands, enemies within 3.5 m take {effects.0.onArrive.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage, are flung 2.5 m outward and are stunned for 1 s, and allied fighters there, Marund included, gain a {effects.0.onArrive.1.onHit.0.amount} shield for 3 s.

fighters.name: Nurrow
fighters.title: Lull singer
fighters.job: Sings everyone around her target to sleep and takes the one left awake.
fighters.lore: Nurrow sang the Lamp Dome's children to sleep for eleven evenings, and on the twelfth she noticed that the quiet in the street was bigger than the song. The lull belongs to her now. She walks the Dialwood at dusk with a snuffer-blade at her hip and a hat shaped like the cap that puts out a lamp, and when a crowd gathers around the one she wants, it forgets to stay awake. She is gentle about it. Serenade neighbours leave bread on their sills for her and do not ask what she does with the quiet she collects.

passive.name: Quiet Kill
passive.desc: When Nurrow gets a takedown, every enemy fighter within 5 m of her falls asleep for 1 s. Damage wakes a sleeper.

a1.name: Felt Step
a1.desc: Nurrow lunges up to 4 m toward a point and stops at the first enemy fighter she reaches, dealing {effects.0.onPass.0.then.0.amount} magic damage. Felt soles: a sleeping enemy takes no damage and stays asleep.

a2.name: Lullaby Dart
a2.desc: Nurrow throws a dart up to 8 m. The first enemy fighter it hits falls asleep for {effects.0.onHit.0.duration}. The dart deals no damage, and damage wakes the sleeper. Felt Step does not wake them; Snuff on a sleeper silences longer and comes back sooner.

a3.name: Snuff
a3.desc: Nurrow snuffs an adjacent enemy for {effects.1.amount} magic damage and silences them for {effects.2.duration}. Snuffing a sleeper deals no extra damage: the silence runs {effects.0.then.1.duration} instead and 70% of the cooldown comes back.

ult.name: Lull the Rest
ult.desc: Nurrow names an enemy fighter within 6 m and lunges at them for {effects.1.onArrive.0.amount} magic damage. Every other enemy fighter within 5 m of that target falls asleep for 2 s.

fighters.name: Odrum
fighters.title: Amber setter
fighters.job: Pours resin under the enemy front line; whoever is still standing in it when it sets is stuck.
fighters.lore: Odrum tends the resin pans that feed the lamps of the east rim, and he learned early that warm lampresin goes where you pour it and stays where it sets. He carries two pots on a walnut yoke and a sling that doubles as a ladle. Serenade cooks complain that he talks about resin at dinner; Aubade runners complain that their boots are still stuck to the Noonline. He is patient in the way of people who wait for things to harden, and he has never once hurried a shot.

passive.name: Cracked Amber
passive.desc: When Odrum roots an enemy, or slows one that is already rooted, the amber cracks: they lose {triggers.0.effects.0.power} armor and {triggers.0.effects.1.power} magic resist for 2.5 s (once per 2 s per enemy).

a1.name: Resin Shot
a1.desc: Odrum lobs resin up to 9 m. It lands after 0.5 s as a 2.5 m pool that slows enemies by 35%. After 1.5 s it sets: enemies still inside take {effects.0.onExpire.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and are rooted for 1 s.

a2.name: Swing Out
a2.desc: Odrum whirls the sling: enemies within 3 m take {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and are slowed by 30% for 1.5 s, and he gains 25% move speed for 1.5 s.

a3.name: Step and Load
a3.desc: Odrum hops up to 3.5 m. His next basic attack within 3 s carries a resin pellet: {effects.1.empowerAttacks.effects.0.amount} bonus physical damage and a 25% slow for 1.5 s.

ult.name: Amber Hour
ult.desc: Odrum hurls a great ball of resin up to 12 m. It lands after 0.75 s as a 5 m pool that slows enemies by 45%. After 2 s it sets: everyone still inside takes {effects.0.onExpire.0.onHit.0.amount} physical damage and is rooted for 1.5 s, so the whole group cracks.

fighters.name: Rishal
fighters.title: Glass runner
fighters.job: Cuts lines of glass through the back line and is gone before anyone can answer.
fighters.lore: Rishal carried messages between the spires of the Glass Belfry until he got bored of stairs. Now he runs the long way across the dial, and wherever his feet strike the stone a thin road of dawnglass sets behind him. Aubade engineers have asked him to slow down so they can study it. He has not. He talks fast, decides faster and treats every fight as a race he is already winning. His two glass knives are older than he is; he says they were a gift, and changes the story each time.

passive.name: Split Glass
passive.desc: Enemies who cross Rishal's glass tracks are Cut (up to 3, for 5 s). His next basic attack on a Cut enemy spends every Cut: each deals {triggers.0.effects.0.perStack.0.amount} bonus physical damage and vents 8 Heat.

a1.name: Glass Dash
a1.desc: Rishal dashes 5 m and leaves a glass track on the ground behind him for 3 s. Enemies on the track when it forms, and enemies who step onto it later, take {effects.0.onEnter.0.amount} physical damage and are Cut. Holds 2 charges.

a2.name: Glint Cut
a2.desc: Rishal slashes an adjacent enemy twice, {effects.0.effects.0.amount} physical damage each. A Cut target is also slowed by 60%, fading over 1 s.

a3.name: Feint
a3.desc: Rishal springs 4 m in the opposite direction to his aim, then lays a glass track over the ground he covered: enemies on it, or who step onto it within 3 s, take {effects.0.onArrive.0.onEnter.0.amount} physical damage and are Cut.

ult.name: Long Glint
ult.desc: Rishal rushes 9 m, unstoppable. Every enemy he passes takes {effects.1.onPass.0.amount} physical damage, gains 3 Cuts and is slowed by 50% for 1 s. The whole line stays a glass track for 4 s that Cuts enemies who step onto it.

fighters.name: Sukri
fighters.title: Rim wanderer
fighters.job: Draws a caught ally back to the group; when he falls low, nobody beside him can be touched for a breath.
fighters.lore: Sukri walks the rim of the dial with a staff over his shoulder and a glass cup of noon light hanging from its crook. He has been walking so long that the cup has grown warm and the staff has grown thin. He keeps the habit of the Hourless: carry what you can for whoever needs it, and never ask whose side they are on. When someone near him falls behind, the cup swings and the road gets shorter. When he falls behind himself, the people around him have learned to stand very still and let the light sort it out.

passive.name: Spare Hour
passive.desc: Once every 90 s, when Sukri drops below 30% health, he and allied fighters within 6 m cannot be targeted for 1 s.

a1.name: Mote Toss
a1.desc: Sukri tosses a mote up to 8 m. After 0.5 s, allies within 2.5 m are healed for {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} and enemies take {effects.1.onHit.0.amount} magic damage.

a2.name: Draw Near
a2.desc: Sukri draws an allied fighter within 7 m up to 5 m toward him and shields them for {effects.1.amount} for 2 s. Cast on himself, it only shields. The pull knocks the ally airborne for 0.25 s, which interrupts a cast in progress.

a3.name: Wrap Cast
a3.desc: Sukri throws a weighted wrap up to 8 m. The first enemy fighter it hits takes {effects.0.onHit.0.amount} magic damage and is rooted for {effects.0.onHit.1.duration}.

ult.name: Gather In
ult.desc: Every allied fighter within 10 m is drawn up to 4 m toward Sukri and shielded for {effects.0.onHit.1.amount} for 4 s. A 4 m ring of dust then slows enemies around him by 30% for 2 s. The pull knocks allies airborne for 0.25 s.

fighters.name: Tunlan
fighters.title: Shadow puppeteer
fighters.job: Throws lamp-shadows of beasts over the enemy line and sends them running.
fighters.lore: At the Noon Fair, Tunlan's lamp-shadow of a hound made a whole street flinch, and she has been working out ever since how much further a shadow can go. Serenade puppeteers have always thrown beasts on the walls of the Lamp Dome for the children. Tunlan throws them over an enemy line, wide and tall and sudden, and the line remembers every old fear it ever had. She wears a hat like a lampshade and never uses the word frightening. She says the shadows are only asking people to go somewhere else.

fighters.title: Dart hunter
fighters.job: Never stops moving: every stride she runs loads her next throw.
fighters.lore: Ulkro has never stood still long enough to be asked where she is from. The Hourless say she was born on the rim road, between one footstep and the next, and she does nothing to correct them. She keeps a long spear-thrower on her left arm and a quiver of darts she calls the evening's worth, because she believes a throw is only as good as the ground you crossed before it. Stop her, and she is a hunter like any other. Let her run, and the dial itself begins to lean her way.

fighters.title: Bell ringer
fighters.job: Rings wide notes over the enemy front line; two humming enemies who stand close form a chord and stop cold.
fighters.lore: Vashil keeps seven small bells on a chalk ring above his visor and strikes them with a rod as long as his arm. Every one of them is tuned a little wrong on purpose. A bell struck once makes people turn. A bell struck twice makes them stop. He learned this in the Glass Belfry, ringing the morning change for a valley that never found its morning, and the only third stroke he rings is the one that ends the fight. He is polite, quick and a little early to everything. His bells are early too.

items.desc: +0.36 m/s move speed, +10 armor, +10 resist and +10% tenacity.

items.name: Chalk Slippers
items.desc: +0.36 m/s move speed and +14 ability haste.

spells.name: Glint Step
spells.desc: Blink up to 4.5 m toward the point. Your shadow stays where you stood for 2.5 s, and enemy fighters who step into it are slowed by 30% for 1 s.

spells.name: Saplight
spells.desc: Set a 3 m pool of sap-light at your feet for 4 s. You and allied fighters standing in it heal 4% of their max health each second.

spells.name: Hairline
spells.desc: Crack an enemy fighter within 6 m: deal 20 + 8 per level damage that ignores armor and resist, and for 4 s its armor and resist are 20% lower and healing on it is 30% weaker.

spells.name: Hourstrike
spells.desc: Strike a monster or Wick within 5 m for 250 + 15 per level plus 12% of its current health as damage that ignores armor and resist, and heal 4% of your max health. The fuller it is, the harder it lands. Holds 3 charges; one returns every 70 s.

spells.name: Shake Loose
spells.desc: Break free of roots and ignore stuns, roots and knockbacks for 1 s, and move 30% faster for 2 s. You cannot cast it while stunned, airborne, asleep, taunted or feared.

spells.name: Glass Pane
spells.desc: Gain a shield of 50 + 12 per level for 4 s. As the pane sets, enemy fighters within 3 m are slowed by 25% for 1.5 s.

spells.name: Calling Bell
spells.desc: You and allied fighters within 7 m move 20% faster for 3 s, and enemy fighters within 9 m are revealed for 4 s.

boons.name: Opening Hour
boons.desc: Your first damage to an enemy fighter deals an extra 12 + 3 per level damage that ignores armor and resist. Once every 10 s per fighter.

boons.name: Keen Edge
boons.desc: Your damage ignores 6% of the target's armor and resist.

boons.name: Next Hour
boons.desc: When you take down an enemy fighter, your ability cooldowns drop by 20% of the time left and you move 25% faster for 2 s.

boons.name: Dense Stone
boons.desc: +50 health, and 10 more for each level after the first (220 at level 18).

boons.name: Second Shadow
boons.desc: When damage drops you below 35% health, gain a shield of 50 + 14 per level for 3 s. Once every 75 s.

boons.name: Slow Heat
boons.desc: While you are below 60% health, heal 3 + 1% of your max health every 4 s.

boons.name: Quick Hour
boons.desc: +6 ability haste, rising by 0.4 for each level after the first (12.8 at level 18).

boons.name: Echo Bell
boons.desc: Every 4th ability you cast, each within 20 s of the last, takes 1.5 s off all your ability cooldowns.

paths.name: Shadeline
paths.desc: Strike first and finish fights: bonus damage, penetration and a reset on takedowns.

paths.name: Warmstone
paths.desc: Stay standing: more health, a shield when you are low and slow healing.

paths.name: Hourturn
paths.desc: Move and cast more often: ability haste, move speed and cooldown refunds.

abilities.name: Glass Bellow
abilities.desc: The Glasshorn lowers its antlers and bellows in a cone: 30 magic damage and a 25% slow for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Resin Spit
abilities.desc: Spits a pool of burning resin that lands after 0.5 s and burns for 3 s: 8 magic damage every 0.5 s to anyone inside.

abilities.name: Still Stamp
abilities.desc: Rears and stamps after 0.7 s: 28 physical damage and a 30% slow for 1 s around it.

abilities.name: Topple
abilities.desc: The numeral tips over toward its target after 0.9 s: 45 physical damage and a 0.5 s stun in a 4 m line.

abilities.name: Shard Rain
abilities.desc: Marks a circle under its target; 1 s later glass shards land there for 110 magic damage.

abilities.name: Noon Glare
abilities.desc: Charges for 1.2 s, then flares in a ring from 3.5 m to 7 m: 100 magic damage and a 30% slow for 1.5 s. Stand close or stand clear.

abilities.name: Splinter Spray
abilities.desc: Turns its broken tip toward its target and sprays a 60 degree cone after 0.9 s: 130 physical damage and a short knockback.

passive.name: Lengthening
passive.desc: Every 8 s it spends taking damage, Longshade gains +15 attack and +5 armor for 20 s, stacking up to 8 times. A long fight makes it stronger.

abilities.name: Shadow Sweep
abilities.desc: Drags its shadow through a wide arc after 1 s: 200 physical damage and a 2.5 m knockback in a 120 degree cone.

abilities.name: Pooled Shade
abilities.desc: Pools shade under a distant target. After 1 s it darkens for 4 s: 40 magic damage every 0.5 s and a 35% slow inside.

abilities.name: Full Length
abilities.desc: Rears to its full length for 1.6 s, then crashes down: 320 magic damage and a 1 s stun to everyone within 5 m. Run while it rises.

teamBuffs.name: Clearglass
teamBuffs.desc: From the Glasshorn, for 90 s: while on your own side of the Noonline, your whole team gains +16 ability haste and +2 resource regeneration per second.

passives.name: Clearglass
passives.desc: While you stand on your own side of the Noonline: +16 ability haste and +2 resource regeneration per second.

teamBuffs.name: Resinburn
teamBuffs.desc: From the Resinback, for 90 s: on the enemy side of the Noonline, your team's attacks stick resin to fighters and monsters (a 20% slow); your next attack on that target ignites it. Once every 4 s per target.

passives.name: Resinburn
passives.desc: On the enemy side of the Noonline, an attack on a fighter or monster sticks resin to it (20% slow for 1.5 s); your next attack on it within 4 s ignites the resin for 20 + 4 per level magic damage. Once every 4 s per target.

teamBuffs.name: Splinters
teamBuffs.desc: From the Sunsplinter, for 4:00: your team gains a Splinter, +5% armor and resist penetration and +5 ability haste. Splinters stack up to 3, and every Sunsplinter you take renews them.

teamBuffs.name: The Long Shade
teamBuffs.desc: From Longshade, for 3:30: your team gains +20 ability haste and +15% tenacity. Your Wicks march tougher, harder-hitting and faster.

teamBuffs.name: Lanternwake
teamBuffs.desc: You broke an enemy Lantern. For 4:00 your Wicks on every road gain +120 health, +10 attack and +10 armor and resist.

modes.name: RIFT
modes.desc: Five against five on three roads. Draft your team, hold the Dialwood and its prizes, and silence the enemy Hourbell.

queues.name: Quick

tips: [rift,bridge] By default, allies glow azure and enemies glow marigold on every map. Settings let you change both.
A glow on an enemy fighter is a warning. When their light flares, an ability is on its way.
Enemy danger areas are brightest at the edge. Step out before the circle closes.
Hold the scoreboard key to see every fighter's items and levels. Let go and it closes.
[rift] Unspent Gleam fights for no one. Recall when you can afford a full item.
[rift] Recall takes about 7 s. Start it somewhere an enemy cannot reach in that time.
Needlegrass hides you from enemies outside it. An enemy standing in the same grass can still see you.
[rift,bridge] A Needle's shadow ring shows how far it can strike. Stay outside it unless you mean to break it.
[rift] A Needle's shadow ring turns aside your blows unless your own Wicks stand in it. Bring the wave.
[rift] Until 8:00 every Outer Needle wears a Dawn Seal that re-sets every 30 s: one wave won't crack it, a stacked wave will.
[rift] Grove tithe: while your Grovehunter trails your team's lead, each camp monster pays it extra XP from what your roads earned.
[rift,bridge] A Lantern holds a road's stored light. When it falls, your team gains Lanternwake until it relights 4:00 later.
[rift] The Glasshorn gives your whole team Clearglass for 90 s: faster cooldowns and quicker Light regeneration while you stand on your own side of the Noonline.
[rift] The Resinback gives your team Resinburn for 90 s. On the enemy side of the Noonline, an attack sticks resin to its target and your next attack ignites it.
[rift] Each Sunsplinter you take adds a Splinter for your team. Longshade, late in the match, gives the living team the Long Shade for sieging.
[rift,bridge] Your ultimate unlocks at level 6, then ranks up at levels 11 and 16.
[bridge] BRIDGE has no recall. Take the Mending Sunmotes that fall on the span, and shop at home, beside your own standing Needles, or while you wait to return.
[bridge] In BRIDGE, you can take one fighter from your team's Lot; yours goes there for a teammate. The Lot burns down one fighter every 8 s.
[bridge] At 21:00 the Gorge Wind rises: nothing loses its protection, but every 45 s the waves hit harder and the Needles wear thin.
[fray] FRAY gives you four lives. First to 12 takedowns or the last one standing wins, and the Hour Board ranks the rest.
[fray] The Lampwright cart on the Noonplate is shared by all ten. Shop between fights, not during them.
[fray] From 8:00 the Noon Toll rings every 20 s and shows every fighter to everyone for 5 s. Late in the match, nobody stays hidden.
Physical damage numbers are chalk and magic damage numbers are orchid-rose. Armor shrinks the first, resist the second.
Numerals in ink with a pale halo are damage that ignores armor and resist.
[rift,bridge] Pings are how your team talks. Say what you see before the fight, not during it.
After a fall, the recap lists the damage you took in the last 15 s. Read it once, then carry on.
Your first win of each day pays a bonus on top of the usual Candles.
[rift] Ranked opens at account level 20. Until then, Quick and Draft are the places to learn.
Quick cast fires an ability the moment you press its key. Turn it on under Settings, Controls.
Colorblind modes change the ally and enemy colors and add a shape to each. Find them under Settings, Accessibility.

strings.recap.held: Held for {t} of the last 15 s.
strings.recap.tip.phys: Most of that was physical damage. Armor shrinks it.
strings.recap.tip.magic: Most of that was magic damage. Resist shrinks it.
strings.recap.tip.pierce: Much of that ignored armor and resist.
strings.recap.tip.mixed: It was a mix of physical and magic damage.
strings.score.title: Scoreboard
strings.hourboard.title: Hour Board
strings.hourboard.hint: Fighters still in are ranked by takedowns, then by damage to fighters. Anyone who is out keeps their place.
strings.stat.hp.name: Health
strings.stat.hp.tip: The damage you can take before you fall.
strings.stat.hpRegen.name: Health regeneration
strings.stat.res.name: Resource
strings.stat.res.tip: The pool your abilities draw on. Its kind depends on the fighter.
strings.stat.resRegen.name: Resource regeneration
strings.stat.ad.name: Attack
strings.stat.ad.tip: Adds to your basic attack damage and to abilities that scale with attack.
strings.stat.ap.name: Power
strings.stat.ap.tip: Adds to the damage and effect of abilities that scale with power.
strings.stat.armor.name: Armor
strings.stat.armor.tip: Reduces physical damage you take. At 100 armor you take half.
strings.stat.resist.name: Resist
strings.stat.resist.tip: Reduces magic damage you take. At 100 resist you take half.
strings.stat.attackSpeed.name: Attack speed
strings.stat.moveSpeed.name: Move speed
strings.stat.moveSpeed.tip: How many meters you cover each second.
strings.stat.moveSpeedPct.name: Move speed bonus
strings.stat.moveSpeedPct.tip: Extra move speed as a percentage of your base.
strings.stat.crit.name: Critical chance
strings.stat.crit.tip: The chance a basic attack lands as a critical strike for extra damage.
strings.stat.critDamage.name: Critical damage
strings.stat.critDamage.tip: How much extra damage a critical strike deals.
strings.stat.lifesteal.name: Life steal
strings.stat.lifesteal.tip: Heals you for a share of the damage your basic attacks deal.
strings.stat.omnivamp.name: Drain
strings.stat.omnivamp.tip: Heals you for a share of all the damage you deal, from attacks and abilities.
strings.stat.haste.name: Ability haste
strings.stat.haste.tip: Shortens ability cooldowns; 100 haste halves them. Hour spells and item actives are not affected.
strings.stat.range.name: Attack range
strings.stat.range.tip: How far away your basic attacks reach, in meters.
strings.stat.armorPen.name: Armor penetration
strings.stat.armorPen.tip: Your attacks and abilities ignore this much of the target's armor.
strings.stat.armorPenPct.name: Armor penetration
strings.stat.armorPenPct.tip: Your attacks and abilities ignore this share of the target's armor.
strings.stat.magicPen.name: Magic penetration
strings.stat.magicPen.tip: Your abilities ignore this much of the target's resist.
strings.stat.magicPenPct.name: Magic penetration
strings.stat.magicPenPct.tip: Your abilities ignore this share of the target's resist.
strings.stat.tenacity.name: Tenacity
strings.stat.tenacity.tip: Shortens stuns, roots, slows, silences, fear, taunts and sleep. Capped at 90%.
strings.stat.healShieldPower.name: Heal and shield power
strings.stat.healShieldPower.tip: Strengthens the heals and shields you give.
strings.stat.kills.name: Takedowns
strings.stat.deaths.name: Falls
strings.stat.deaths.tip: The number of times you fell.
strings.stat.assists.name: Assists
strings.stat.kda.name: T / F / A
strings.stat.cs.name: Wicks
strings.stat.cs.tip: Wicks and monsters you finished off. Each pays Gleam.
strings.stat.gold.name: Gleam
strings.stat.gold.tip: The currency you spend at the Lampwright.
strings.stat.goldEarned.name: Gleam earned
strings.stat.goldEarned.tip: All the Gleam you earned this match, spent or not.
strings.stat.damage.name: Damage to fighters
strings.stat.damage.tip: Damage you dealt to enemy fighters.
strings.stat.damageTaken.name: Damage taken
strings.stat.healing.name: Healing
strings.stat.healing.tip: Health and shield you gave, yourself included.
strings.stat.structureDamage.name: Structure damage
strings.stat.structureDamage.tip: Damage you dealt to enemy structures.
strings.stat.streak.name: Streak
strings.stat.streak.tip: Takedowns in a row without falling. A long streak raises your bounty.
strings.stat.bounty.name: Bounty
strings.stat.bounty.tip: The Gleam paid to whoever takes this fighter down. It grows with a streak.
strings.stat.level.name: Level
strings.stat.level.tip: Higher levels strengthen your fighter and unlock ability ranks.
strings.stat.xp.name: XP
strings.stat.xp.tip: Experience toward the next level. It is shared by fighters near a fall.
strings.stat.difficulty.name: Difficulty
strings.stat.difficulty.tip: How much practice a fighter needs.
strings.status.stun.name: Stunned
strings.status.root.name: Rooted
strings.status.root.tip: Cannot move. Can still attack and cast.
strings.status.slow.name: Slowed
strings.status.silence.name: Silenced
strings.status.silence.tip: Cannot cast abilities. Hour spells and items still work.
strings.status.disarm.name: Disarmed
strings.status.airborne.name: Airborne
strings.status.airborne.tip: Lifted off the ground and cannot act.
strings.status.taunt.name: Taunted
strings.status.taunt.tip: Forced to attack whoever taunted it.
strings.status.fear.name: Feared
strings.status.fear.tip: Forced to walk away and cannot attack or cast.
strings.status.sleep.name: Asleep
strings.status.sleep.tip: Cannot act until it takes damage.
strings.status.haste.name: Hasted
strings.status.invisible.name: Hidden
strings.status.invisible.tip: Cannot be seen by enemies until it attacks or casts.
strings.status.untargetable.name: Untargetable
strings.status.untargetable.tip: Enemies cannot target or hit it.
strings.status.unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
strings.status.unstoppable.tip: Cannot be stopped by stuns, roots, fear, taunts or sleep.
strings.status.reveal.name: Revealed
strings.status.reveal.tip: Visible to the enemy team through fog, grass and invisibility.
strings.status.grievous.name: Wounded
strings.status.armor_shred.name: Armor broken
strings.status.resist_shred.name: Resist broken
strings.hint.attack: Right-click an enemy to attack. Shift + right-click to attack-move: stop and hit what is in range.

strings.hint.ping: Hold {ping} to open the wheel. Pings are how your team talks.
strings.hint.recall: Recall takes you home. Start it where no enemy can reach you.
strings.hint.scoreboard: Hold {scoreboard} to see everyone's level and items.

strings.postgame.defeat.sub.generic: The light holds for another day.

strings.postgame.fray.sub.2: You kept your hour longer than eight others.

strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.changes_saved: Changes are saved as you make them.
strings.calibrate.notice: Graphics set to {preset} so the vale runs smoothly on this machine.
strings.settings.video.preset.label: Quality preset
strings.settings.video.preset.desc: Sets the options below together. Changing any one of them switches this to Custom.
strings.settings.video.renderScale.label: Render scale
strings.settings.video.renderScale.desc: Draws the game at this share of your screen's size. Lower is faster and softer.
strings.settings.video.shadows.label: Shadows
strings.settings.video.shadows.desc: Shadow detail. Off is the fastest.
strings.settings.video.ao.label: Ambient occlusion
strings.settings.video.ao.desc: Soft contact shadows where objects meet the ground.
strings.settings.video.bloom.label: Bloom
strings.settings.video.bloom.desc: The soft halo around bright light. Danger areas read the same with it off.
strings.settings.video.antialias.label: Edge smoothing
strings.settings.video.antialias.desc: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA is light and MSAA is heavier and sharper.
strings.settings.video.particles.label: Effects detail
strings.settings.video.particles.desc: How many sparks, chips and shards effects throw.
strings.settings.video.scatter.label: Scenery detail
strings.settings.video.scatter.desc: Grass, stones and small props across the map.
strings.settings.video.ambientEffects.label: Ambient life
strings.settings.video.ambientEffects.desc: Drifting motes, lamp flames and small creatures away from the fights. Banners still sway.
strings.settings.video.fpsCap.label: Frame rate limit
strings.settings.video.fpsCap.desc: Caps frames per second to save power and heat.
strings.settings.video.maxDpr.label: Sharpness
strings.settings.video.maxDpr.desc: The highest pixel ratio the game draws at. Higher is sharper on dense screens and costs more.
strings.settings.video.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen
strings.settings.video.dynamicResolution.label: Dynamic resolution
strings.settings.video.dynamicResolution.desc: When frames run long, draws a little below your render scale for a moment, then climbs back. Off: always your render scale.
strings.settings.video.note: Every quality level draws danger areas the same way.
strings.settings.audio.master.label: Master volume
strings.settings.audio.music.label: Music
strings.settings.audio.sfx.label: Effects
strings.settings.audio.voice.label: Announcer
strings.settings.audio.voice.desc: Announcer tones for takedowns and objectives.
strings.settings.audio.ui.label: Interface
strings.settings.audio.ambience.label: Ambience
strings.settings.audio.ambience.desc: Wind and the sounds of each map.
strings.settings.audio.muteInBackground.label: Mute in the background
strings.settings.audio.muteInBackground.desc: Silences the game while this tab is hidden.
strings.settings.audio.mono.label: Mono
strings.settings.audio.mono.desc: Plays the whole mix in both ears. For one-sided hearing or a single earbud.
strings.settings.audio.softenLoud.label: Soften loud sounds
strings.settings.audio.softenLoud.desc: Turns down sudden loud hits and blasts so the mix stays even.
strings.settings.credits.title: Credits & licenses
strings.settings.credits.intro: VALE is built with the open-source code and typefaces below. Each is used under its license.
strings.settings.credits.notices_missing: The full license texts ship with the game as {file}.
strings.settings.credits.use.heading: Headings, labels and prose figures
strings.settings.credits.use.mesh: Compressed 3D models and their detail levels
strings.settings.controls.binds.title: Keys
strings.settings.controls.binds.desc: Click a key, then press the key or mouse button you want.
strings.settings.controls.press_key: Press a key or mouse button for {action}.
strings.settings.controls.quickCast.label: Quick cast
strings.settings.controls.quickCast.desc: Abilities fire at the cursor the moment you press their key.
strings.settings.controls.cameraLock.label: Lock camera to your fighter
strings.settings.controls.cameraLock.desc: Keeps the camera centered on your fighter.
strings.settings.controls.edgePan.label: Edge pan
strings.settings.controls.edgePan.desc: Move the cursor to a screen edge to scroll the camera.
strings.settings.controls.panSpeed.label: Pan speed
strings.settings.controls.attackMoveOnClick.desc: Move commands also attack enemies you pass.
strings.settings.controls.selfCastModifier.label: Self-cast key
strings.settings.controls.selfCastModifier.desc: Hold this key with an ability to cast it on yourself.
strings.settings.access.colorblind.label: Colorblind mode
strings.settings.access.colorblind.desc: Changes the ally and enemy colors. Shape codes stay on in every mode.
strings.settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.off: Allies are Dawn azure and enemies are Dusk marigold.
strings.settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.deut: Enemies shift to a brighter yellow-orange. Allies shift slightly toward cyan.
strings.settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.prot: Enemies shift to a brighter yellow-orange.
strings.settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.trit: Enemies shift to a rose-red. Allies shift slightly toward cyan.
strings.settings.access.colors.title: Team colors
strings.settings.access.colors.desc: Your color is Noonwhite. Neutral things are Dialstone.
strings.settings.access.colors.warn: These two colors are hard to tell apart. Pick colors further apart.
strings.settings.access.fray.label: FRAY seat colors
strings.settings.access.fray.desc: How the other nine fighters are drawn in FRAY. Each seat always has its own glyph.
strings.settings.access.fray.opt_desc.auto: Stamp-forward when a colorblind mode is on, otherwise Standard.
strings.settings.access.fray.opt_desc.standard: Ten seat colors, each with its glyph.
strings.settings.access.fray.opt_desc.stamp: Glyphs at 150% and a stronger fill, so each seat reads by shape first.
strings.settings.access.fray.opt_desc.simple: Everyone else is drawn in the enemy color with their glyph, so only you stand out.
strings.settings.access.uiScale.label: UI scale
strings.settings.access.hudScale.label: HUD scale
strings.settings.access.hudScale.desc: Resizes the in-match bars, frames and feeds.
strings.settings.access.minimapScale.label: Minimap scale
strings.settings.access.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
strings.settings.access.reduceMotion.desc: Replaces sweeps and camera moves with short fades.
strings.settings.access.screenShake.label: Screen shake
strings.settings.access.screenShake.desc: How hard the screen shakes on big hits. Zero turns it off.
strings.settings.access.locFlash.label: Loss-of-control edge
strings.settings.access.locFlash.desc: Marks the screen's edge in the enemy color for a moment when you are stunned, knocked up, put to sleep, taunted or feared.
strings.settings.access.damageFlash.label: Hit edge
strings.settings.access.damageFlash.desc: Darkens the screen's edge for a moment when a hit lands on you.
strings.settings.access.subtitles.label: Subtitles
strings.settings.access.subtitles.desc: Shows announcer text for takedowns, objectives and structures.
strings.settings.gameplay.showDamageNumbers.desc: Shows your own hits, and heals of 5% of max health or more.
strings.settings.gameplay.showAllyIndicators.des: Shows frames and marks for allied fighters.
strings.settings.gameplay.healthBarTicks.label: Health bar ticks
strings.settings.gameplay.healthBarTicks.desc: Marks every 100 health on bars, with a heavier mark every 1,000.
strings.settings.gameplay.hudLedger.label: Your ledger line
strings.settings.gameplay.hudLedger.desc: Shows your takedowns, falls, assists and Wicks under the sky strip.
strings.settings.gameplay.minimapSide.label: Minimap side
strings.settings.gameplay.minimapSide.desc: Which bottom corner the minimap sits in.
strings.net.online_tip: Matchmade queues play online with other players; bots fill the empty seats.
strings.net.offline_tip: The game server is not reachable: queues play against bots. VALE keeps trying in the background.
